final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT r.ordervault, o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS n FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.timespan), step2 AS (SELECT timespan, SUM(n) AS total FROM step1 GROUP BY timespan), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS grand_total FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT s2.timespan, s2.total, 1.0 * s2.total / s3.grand_total AS share FROM step2 AS s2 JOIN step3 AS s3 ON s3.grand_total IS NOT NULL), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM step4) SELECT s4.timespan, s4.total, s4.share, s4.share - s5.mean_share FROM step4 AS s4 JOIN step5 AS s5 ON s5.mean_share IS NOT NULL
